audioFormat.description: Format used when Audio only is on.
audioFormat.title: Audio file format

audioOnly.description: Download only the audio track of videos. Photos and GIFs are skipped. Files are extracted with ffmpeg and need the save files option.
audioOnly.title: Audio only (extract sound from videos)

downloadAllQualities.description: Emit and download one separate file for every progressive MP4 quality X offers (for example 1080p, 720p, 480p) instead of only the preferred one. Every quality gets its own row, filename and download link.
downloadAllQualities.title: Download every video quality

imageQuality.description: Quality to use for photos (and video poster images). Original is the full-resolution file posted on X.
imageQuality.title: Photo quality

includeAltText.description: Attach the alt text (image description) X stores for each photo or video thumbnail to the media row.
includeAltText.title: Include image alt text

includeMetadata.description: Attach the post text, like/repost/reply/view counts, the uploader's follower count and a derived engagement rate to every downloaded file.
includeMetadata.title: Include post metadata

includePosterImage.description: Save the thumbnail/poster image of each video or GIF as an additional photo file.
includePosterImage.title: Also save video poster images

includeQuotedMedia.description: Also download the photos, videos and GIFs that appear inside a quoted post (a post embedded in the linked post). Those rows are marked with mediaSource "quoted post".
includeQuotedMedia.title: Include media from quoted posts

includeThumbnails.description: Alias of save video poster images. When either option is on, the video thumbnail is stored as an extra photo.
includeThumbnails.title: Include thumbnails (alias)

maxPostsPerUser.description: How many recent posts to look at for each username. Posts without matching media are skipped.
maxPostsPerUser.title: Maximum posts to check per username

mediaTypes.description: Choose which kinds of media to download. All types are selected by default.
mediaTypes.title: Media types to download

postUrls.description: Paste links of posts to download media from. Accepts x.com and twitter.com links, i/web/status links, or bare post IDs. Optional if you provide usernames or profile links below.
postUrls.title: Post links or IDs

profileUrls.description: Alias of usernames to scan. Paste x.com or twitter.com profile links or bare handles.
profileUrls.title: Profile links to scan (alias)

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use an Apify proxy if you plan large runs or see frequent rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

saveToFile.description: Download each file into this run's key-value store and add a public signed download link. Turn off to collect metadata only.
saveToFile.title: Save files and return download links

tweetUrls.description: Alias of post links. Accepts tweet links, bare tweet IDs and profile links.
tweetUrls.title: Tweet links or IDs (alias)

usernames.description: Scan recent posts from these profiles and download their media. Type handles with or without @, or paste full profile links. Optional if you provide post links above.
usernames.title: Usernames or profile links to scan

videoQuality.description: Preferred video resolution. The actor picks the closest available quality when the exact one is not offered.
videoQuality.title: Video quality
